scripts.lint: bun run --cwd apps/api lint && bun run --cwd apps/cms lint
scripts.lint:fix: bun run --cwd apps/api lint:fix && bun run --cwd apps/cms lint:fix
scripts.format: bun run --cwd apps/api format && bun run --cwd apps/cms format
scripts.format:check: bun run --cwd apps/api format:check && bun run --cwd apps/cms format:check
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/cms typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd apps/api test && bun run --cwd apps/cms test
